title: Tithe-Cart Drover
text: Tithe-Cart Drover steers a rattling collection cart across the route and sweeps unattended gear into its locked bins. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The cart is never full, only overdue.

defeatReward.text: Tithe-Cart Drover is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
